description:
Payload for ``message_type='registered'``.

The coordinator's answer to ``register``. Registration can legitimately
be refused — an agent may not be approved, or may declare a capability
it is not permitted to offer — and without this answer the agent has no
way to tell refusal from success, so it would keep serving nothing while
believing it was live.

reason.description: Why registration was refused. Empty when accepted.
reason.title: Reason

registered_capabilities.description: Capability IDs the coordinator actually accepted.
registered_capabilities.title: Registered Capabilities

coordinator_protocol_version.description: The LIP version the coordinator implements, so an agent can detect a mismatch rather than inferring it from failures.
coordinator_protocol_version.title: Coordinator Protocol Version

title: LIP registered payload
